ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is a centrally symmetric figure with $A$ as the center of symmetry. If $\angle C=90^\circ$, $\angle B=30^\circ$, and $AC=3$, what is the length of $BB'$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In the right triangle $ABC$, $\angle B=30^\circ$, $AC=3$,\\ 
$\therefore AB=2AC=6$,\\
$\because$ B and B' are centrally symmetric about A,\\
$\therefore BB'=2AB=\boxed{12}$.
